title: H-CARSTACK-1 attempt 1 (2026-09-28): the host judged an INDOOR client by its avatar, which the mover snaps to the interior's coordinates (a detached island 700-800 m from the city), so every walk-in beside the host flipped the client to its OWN traffic and every walk-out flipped it back onto the host's ghosts - the stacked cars. Fixed: an indoor player is judged by its last OUTSIDE position, as the host judges itself. (a) The host stands inside his salon; the client walks in and out of that shop and the neighbouring gym 3 times: the host's flip counter for the client and the client's applied seq never move. (b) CONTROL: the client far away -> local; back at the door -> ghost. REPORT per leg: [CarStack] LIFTED / [CarHit] counts. NO save. FOLD G1/G2 (2026-09-28): an UNDERGROUND GARAGE is not a building to the game (IsInsideBuilding stays false), so a garage player shipped an empty tag with garage coordinates and the host took them as its last street position. The sender now ships '<n> ba:street_parking' and the host judges a garage stay by the street position before it. (c) The client walks in and out of the garage nearest the neighbouring door x2 and from the garage up the elevator into its building: the host's flip counter and the client's applied seq never move; the garage player stays SHOWN on the host.
preconditions: Reporter fixture session fx-hq1 (MERGED - vars.keepMerger true): '58 ba:street_fifthavenue' is the host's salon, '60 ba:street_fifthavenue' Client1's gym next door. Dev build with the `traffic` readout tail (host: peers=<pid>:<mode>:<flip seq>; client: mseq=<applied seq> near=<own reading>; both: at=x,y,z). enterbuilding teleports, so each player first enters and leaves its door once to make its last outside position the door. ORACLE NOTE: NullReferenceException carries the `(?<!swallowed )` lookbehind (fx-hq1's own Gley diagnostic). Garage leg: `parking list 200` from the client at the neighbouring door must find a garage entrance within 200 m (the mode band is 250/350 m), `parking goto/enter/exit/elevator` drive the game's own UndergroundParkingManager path and the elevator's EnterBuilding.
